implementation: New rune-platform workspace crate, independent of UI and providers. Core and Desktop do not depend on it at this checkpoint.
One selected regular-file descriptor, not its contents, leaves the chooser. Public errors and Debug redact local paths.

Local file URI validation before URL normalization rejects dot segments, remote authorities, malformed escapes, raw controls and oversized responses; encoded literal filenames and non-UTF8 filenames remain supported.
One fixed filesystem thread and bounded queue survive cancellation/reconnection; descriptor open is read-only and nonblocking, then fstat verifies regular type and size. No file contents are read.
A dedicated session-bus connection watches portal owner changes and subscribes to the exact request Response before OpenFile. Early signals cannot publish until the returned handle matches.
Cancellation, deadline, owner loss and dropped futures close only the owned request. Failed Close retires the connection; reuse waits for cleanup and any prior filesystem work.
RuntimeBound polls and destroys the complete future within the captured original Tokio runtime, including zbus stream destructors. It creates no runtime and uses no unsafe code.

limits: Linux portal was tested with the local GTK backend. Windows and macOS selection remain unavailable; Wayland currently uses no exported parent handle, which can affect placement/focus.
The 25 MiB example limit is a local QA policy, not a verified provider upload limit.
Useful Response data is capped at 64 KiB and URI length at 4096 bytes. These are not a total process RSS cap; zbus has additional wire-message/queue allocations.
A filesystem syscall cannot be force-cancelled. At most one worker/job per retained chooser survives; a subsequent operation drains it before opening another dialog.
The original Tokio runtime must stay alive and be driven for asynchronous cleanup to complete. Runtime shutdown/paused current-thread execution cannot guarantee it.
Native selection proves descriptor identity and size, not content reading, upload, physical keyboard input, screen-reader behavior, or all window geometries.

REA samples processes, inherits unrecorded environment, and snapshots opt-in filesystem paths; it does not trace network or syscalls. Prelaunch executable hashing does not atomically bind the OS image.
Real-account SQLite, invitation acceptance and read_state remain disabled. No new authenticated service operations were performed.
